name: Mutual Non-Disclosure Agreement (Standard Terms)
description: Common Paper standard mutual NDA terms that let two parties disclose confidential information to each other for a stated purpose, with standard confidentiality, exceptions, term, and return/destruction provisions.

name: Mutual Non-Disclosure Agreement (Cover Page)
description: Cover page for the Common Paper Mutual NDA that captures the deal-specific variables (purpose, effective date, term, governing law) and incorporates the Mutual NDA Standard Terms by reference.

name: Cloud Service Agreement
description: Common Paper standard agreement for selling and buying cloud software and SaaS products, covering service access, payment, data privacy, warranties, liability, indemnification, and confidentiality.

name: Service Level Agreement
description: Common Paper standard SLA designed to be used alongside the Cloud Service Agreement, defining uptime targets, response times, service credits, and remedies for unmet performance commitments.

name: Professional Services Agreement
description: Common Paper standard agreement for providing professional services under one or more statements of work, covering deliverables, intellectual property, payment, warranties, and liability.

name: Data Processing Agreement
description: Common Paper standard DPA governing the processing of personal data between a provider and customer, including subprocessors, international data transfers (EEA SCCs/UK Addendum), security incidents, and audit rights.

name: Design Partner Agreement
description: Common Paper standard agreement giving an early customer access to a product in exchange for feedback and participation in a design partner program, prior to a full commercial relationship.

name: Software License Agreement
description: Common Paper standard agreement for licensing on-premises or installed software, covering license grants, restrictions, updates, open source components, warranties, and liability.

name: Partnership Agreement
description: Common Paper standard agreement for business partnerships involving mutual obligations, trademark licensing, fees, and confidentiality between two companies.

name: Business Associate Agreement
description: Common Paper standard HIPAA business associate agreement governing the use and protection of protected health information (PHI) between a covered entity and a business associate.

name: Pilot Agreement
description: Common Paper standard short-term trial or evaluation agreement that lets a prospective customer test a product before committing to a full commercial agreement.

name: AI Addendum
description: Common Paper standard addendum supplementing a commercial agreement to govern the use of AI services, including input/output ownership, model training permissions, and AI-specific disclaimers.
